title: DSA — Hard Tier

Coin Change: min coins for amount, from coin[] (unbounded).
Minimum Window Substring: smallest substring of `s` containing all chars of `t`.

Course Schedule: given numCourses and prerequisites [[a,b]], can you finish all?
